title: SonarCloud High-Risk Issues Remediation - Phase 2 (38 Deferred Issues)
objective: Systematically remediate 38 remaining high-risk SonarCloud defects across 4 phased waves with zero regressions. Security-review ReDoS fixes, refactor high-complexity validators, migrate 8-param functions to options objects, and eliminate architectural async-constructor pattern. Each phase independently shippable with full validation gates.

stress_test.blast_radius: Phase 1: Template script breakage affects local validation only. Phase 2: Validator bugs could break site generation for all clients. Phase 3: Regex bugs could introduce SECURITY VULNERABILITIES (command injection, sanitization bypass) or AVAILABILITY ISSUES (ReDoS in production). Phase 4: Factory pattern bugs affect validation-executor instantiation across repo.
stress_test.rollback: Per-phase git revert commits. Phase 1: Revert options-object changes, restore 8-param signatures. Phase 2: Revert helper extractions, restore monolithic validators. Phase 3 (CRITICAL): Emergency revert all regex changes if any production security incident, restore original patterns. Phase 4: Revert static factory, restore constructor pattern. Each phase independently revertible via git revert <phase-commit-sha>.

risks.risk: Phase 2 validator refactoring introduces subtle behavioral regression in edge case validation (e.g. route slug normalization, special characters in business names)
risks.mitigation: Add comprehensive unit tests before refactoring. Run full E2E site generation tests with 3+ domain specs covering edge cases. Compare validation output before/after refactor byte-for-byte.

risks.risk: Phase 3 ReDoS regex changes alter matching behavior on production data edge cases not covered by fuzz corpus
risks.mitigation: Generate fuzz corpus from production data samples if available. Include unicode, special chars, max-length inputs. Require 800k+ test cases minimum. Security review includes production data validation.

risks.risk: Security reviewer unavailable or blocks all 6 regex changes, stalling Phase 3 for weeks
risks.mitigation: Establish self-review protocol: if external reviewer unavailable within 48h, proceed with (1) documented fuzz equivalence, (2) security checklist self-audit, (3) staged rollout with monitoring, (4) async post-merge review.

risks.risk: Existing test coverage insufficient, refactored functions break but tests still pass (false positive test quality)
risks.mitigation: Pre-validation step: inject intentional bugs into target functions, verify tests catch them. If not, add failing-then-passing test cases before refactoring. Require mutation testing or manual break-test validation.

risks.risk: Phase 1 API-breaking changes discovered in external caller (e.g. user-maintained scripts importing lib.mjs)
risks.mitigation: Keep deprecated 8-param signatures with console.warn for 2+ releases. Document migration in CHANGELOG. Search codebase for dynamic calls (eval, apply, call patterns).

risks.risk: SonarCloud does not re-analyze PR or reports false negatives, issues not closed despite fix
risks.mitigation: Manual SonarCloud issue review via /api/issues/search after merge. Trigger re-analysis manually if needed. Document actual vs expected closure in validation checkpoint.
